about.title: One line, one story
about.intro: SOFTLINEBY.CLA is a tattoo world where the finesse of the line guides every piece: delicate, legible work designed to feel like you.
about.approach: Fine line is all about precision: thin lines, soft shading and details that must stay legible over time. Every project is adapted to the placement, the size and your skin, so the tattoo ages gracefully.
about.process: It all starts with your idea. We refine it together — style, placement, proportions — then the design is prepared for you and can still be adjusted before the needle comes in.
about.experience: A calm, attentive moment: we take the time to explain, answer your questions and guide you all the way through aftercare.
about.universe: Flowers and botanicals, handwritten lettering, minimal symbols and small illustrations: a soft visual language, feminine or neutral, always drawn with care.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what data this website collects, why, how long it is kept and how to exercise your rights (GDPR).
privacy.controller: The data controller is {name}. For any question about your data: {email}.
data: Appointment request: first name, last name, email address, language, requested date and time, estimated length, project description and, if you provide them, placement, size, style, comment and reference images.
Contact form: first name, last name, email address, subject and message.
Security: a non-reversible fingerprint of your IP address is used for a few minutes to limit abuse (repeated submissions).
purposes: Handling your appointment request and replying to you (pre-contractual measures, Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
Replying to your messages (legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures).
Protecting the website against abuse and spam (legitimate interest, Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacy.recipients: Your data is only accessible to the artist. It is hosted and processed by technical providers: Vercel (website hosting), Neon (database), Google (sending emails via Gmail, private Google Calendar and private Google Sheets tracking). These providers may process data outside the European Union under appropriate safeguards (EU-US Data Privacy Framework or standard contractual clauses). Your data is never sold or used for advertising.
retention: Reference images: automatically deleted {attachmentDays} days after the appointment or the closing of the request.
Appointment requests and messages: anonymised {months} months after the appointment or receipt.
Anti-abuse data: a few minutes, 24 hours at most.
privacy.rights: You may request access to, rectification, erasure or portability of your data, or object to its processing, by writing to {email}. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Belgian Data Protection Authority (dataprotectionauthority.be).
privacy.cookies: This website uses no analytics, advertising or social media cookies. Only strictly necessary cookies may be set: remembering your chosen language (NEXT_LOCALE) and, for the administrator only, the private area session cookie. No consent banner is therefore required.
privacy.security: All exchanges are encrypted (HTTPS). Reference images are stored privately and can only be accessed after the artist has signed in.
